findings.body: Version 1 stores a contact-address placeholder, and this line substitutes the deployment address when the notice is read. Changing that configuration changes the text served for the same version, while consent records still identify only the version. Store the complete text that members actually accept as an immutable version.

findings.body: The test takes its expected text from the migrated database row, then checks only a few phrases in the served notice. Removing a required paragraph from the migration would leave those assertions passing. The integration test needs an independent expectation for the complete approved text.
